description: A delegation chain that cannot be walked to the top reports no depth at all.
note: A partial count is worse than none. Reporting depth 1 for a chain whose next link is not registered says ONE HOP FROM THE ACCOUNTABLE AUTHORITY, a claim about accountability nobody checked. Unverifiable delegated authority is not authority, and an unverifiable depth is not a depth. The mode still says delegated because an agent did act -- only the distance is unknown.
